headword: {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}

definitions.gloss: price increase; price rise; price escalation
definitions.explanation: An increase in the price of goods, services, or assets. A fundamental economic concept frequently discussed in news, business, and everyday conversation about the cost of living.

examples.japanese: {食料品|しょくりょうひん}の{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The rise in food prices continues.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}が{製品|せいひん}の{値段|ねだん}に{反映|はんえい}されている。
examples.english: The rise in raw material prices is reflected in product prices.

examples.japanese: {円安|えんやす}の{影響|えいきょう}で{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}の{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}が{家計|かけい}を{圧迫|あっぱく}している。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, rising import prices are squeezing household budgets.

notes:
Composed of {価格|かかく} (price) + {上昇|じょうしょう} (rise, increase). A staple of economic reporting and business news. In recent years, discussions of {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう} have become even more common in Japan due to inflationary pressures after decades of deflation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急激|きゅうげき}な{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}: sharp price increase
- {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}が{続|つづ}く: price increases continue
- {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}を{抑|おさ}える: to curb price increases
- {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}{率|りつ}: rate of price increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {値上|ねあ}げ: price hike — more colloquial, implies a deliberate increase by sellers
- {物価上昇|ぶっかじょうしょう}: rise in commodity prices — focuses on general cost of living
- インフレ: inflation — the broader economic phenomenon
- {高騰|こうとう}: soaring, skyrocketing — implies dramatic or sudden increases
